description: This file contains the implementation of the ProductImageDao interface, specifically the ProductImageDaoImpl class, which extends a generic DAO implementation. The class provides a method to fetch ProductImage entities from the database by ID, utilizing QueryDSL with JPQL for constructing the query with joins and fetches.

classes.name: ProductImageDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ProductImageDao interface for product image data access, with a method to retrieve product images by their ID.

methods.name: getProductImageById
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductImage entity from the database by ID, constructing a JPQL query with multiple joins and fetches to gather associated descriptions, product, and merchant store data.
